notes: The following rewards were awarded during this event, based on Event Points accumulated over the course of the event:
Starting at 4,000,000 Event Points, the player obtains 50 R Jewels every 500,000 Event Points.

The Card Trader EX appears during this event and remained open until one week after its conclusion (August 10, 2018). The player can trade their EX Jewels for cards, Booster Items, and Gold. Each card and Booster Item can only be obtained once from the Card Trader EX during this event, but the Gold can be obtained any number of times.

When Dueling against Zane Truesdale Level 40 or higher (in both regular and Underworld Duels), these are the only cards that can drop; at lower levels, cards from the standard pool for Legendary Duelists may also drop.

rows.text: "Cyberdark Horn", "Cyberdark Edge", "Cyberdark Keel", "Cyberdark Cannon", "Cyberdark Claw", "Cyberdark Impact!"
